summary: Los Padres NF lookout built 1927 on Reyes Peak, destroyed by the 1932 Matilija Fire and not rebuilt; footing pipes and debris remained at the 2011 visit.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan 4AR cabin with a 14 by 14 ft cab on an open timber tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed by the Matilija Fire in September 1932 and not rebuilt; only footing pipes and debris were left at the 2011 visit

staffing.status: staffed; lookout William Green was at the post when the 1932 fire arrived

access.note: Reached by a one-mile walk from the Reyes Peak trailhead; no closure appears in the sources read, but the newest visit described is from 2011

visit.trail_note: About one mile from the Reyes Peak trailhead, steep in places (Carey, 2011)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service register describes a 20 foot open timber tower; Carey describes a 14 foot wooden frame under the cab. The record uses the register's 20 feet (6.1 m) and notes the difference.
Elevation differs by source: 7,492 ft (2,284 m) on the register, 7,514 ft on Carey's post, and 7,525 ft on Peakbagging. The brief's 2,283.6 m matches the register.

notes_for_editor: Built 1927 and destroyed 1932 agree across four sources. Height differs (20 ft register vs 14 ft Carey). No new photos with direct URLs captured; firetower.org photos (Ranger and Mrs. Green, 1928; site today, Carey) were not downloaded. Access level 'public' is inferred from the trail walk Carey describes; no closure notice was found. The 2011 visit is the latest description, so the current site condition is unverified.
